please_wait_for_the_current_request: Please wait for the current request.

demo_updated_no_device_playback_was_chan: Demo updated. No device playback was changed.

control_your_music_over_a_local_connecti: Control your music over a local connection. Audio stays on your player.
request_failed: Request failed. Refresh this section and check your connection.
playlist_no_files: Only playlist membership changes. Files stay on DISC.
playlist_playback_later: You can edit this playlist. Playlist playback will be added separately.
playlist_empty: Create a playlist in the Playlists section first.
seek_paused: Seek to {position} sent. Waiting for a position update after playback resumes.
seek_unconfirmed: Position unconfirmed. The command was not repeated.
track_changed: The track changed. Choose the position again.
album_unavailable: DISC did not supply an album for this row
source_action_unavailable: This action is not yet available for this source
import_description: Bring an album folder to DISC, scan the card, then save the updated collection here.
import_formats: Audio files up to 2 GB · folder structure preserved · CUE and artwork skipped
import_scan_description: Scan the memory card after transferring. The discovered count covers the player’s library; it does not confirm every uploaded file.
import_not_sent: Not sent. Check the connection and whether the file already exists on the card.
import_uncertain: Result unconfirmed. Check your player before transferring again.
import_scan_uncertain: Completion unconfirmed. Your player may still be scanning.
import_demo_notice: Demo: a preview of the process. Files are not stored and the library stays unchanged.
import_invalid: Choose up to 1,000 audio files, each between 1 byte and 2 GB. Paths must be valid and unique.
import_connect: Connect your DISC to transfer music.
import_scan_ready: Files transferred. Start a scan on DISC next.
import_stop_batch: Transfer stopped. Remaining files have not been sent.
import_exists: This name is already present on the card. Choose a different filename.
import_scan_not_sent: Scan not started. Check the connection and player state.
import_folder_drop: Use “Choose folder” to preserve the album’s folder structure.
connection_saved: The address is saved in this browser. Use the button to connect.
connection_discovery_help: Search listens for DISC announcements on this computer’s local network. A player with an active connection may not appear.
connection_none: No announcements. Check Wi-Fi and disconnect any other player client. You can also enter its IP manually.
connection_no_interface: No network interface found. Enter your player’s IP manually.
connection_search_failed: Could not listen on this network. Check local-network permission or enter the player IP manually.
connection_invalid: Enter a local IPv4 address and ports from 1 to 65535.
connection_failed: Connection not established. Check the address, power and player availability; connection attempts continue until you disconnect.
connection_changed: The connection changed. Check the address and press Connect again.
connection_demo: Networking is disabled in demo mode. Start DISC Web without --demo to connect.
connection_candidate: Address from a network announcement · connect after selecting
catalogue_intro: Save the catalog for fast search and browsing offline. Music stays on DISC.
catalogue_stale: May have changed — sync when needed
catalogue_syncing: Reading and verifying the catalog · pages: {count}
catalogue_failed: Sync is unavailable or interrupted. The previous saved collection has not been replaced.
catalogue_error_membership: Album membership did not match the full track list.
catalogue_error_ambiguous: The player returned ambiguous album names.
catalogue_error_invalid: The player returned inconsistent catalog positions.
catalogue_error_limit: A catalog response is missing or exceeds the read limit.
catalogue_error_connection: Reading from the player could not complete.
catalogue_error_unavailable: The catalog could not be verified. Sync again when the player is idle.
catalogue_error_identity_timeout: DISC did not reply to the firmware identity request.
search_empty_albums: Try another album title or artist. Search stays in this section.
search_empty_artists: Try another artist name. Search stays in this section.
search_empty_tracks: Try another track title, album or artist. Search stays in this list.
queue_snapshot_note: Order at refresh time. In shuffle mode, the player chooses the next track.
catalogue_activity_catalog: Reading and comparing the catalog · pages received: {count}
catalogue_activity_enrichment: Saving available current-track artwork and duration…
catalogue_activity_verification: Checking consistency before saving the collection…
catalogue_metadata_unavailable: Saved track details could not be read. Artwork and duration coverage is unknown.
catalogue_metadata_note: The player provides artwork and duration for the current track only. These are saved when the track can be matched safely, without switching music. Other details remain unknown. Counts refer to this saved collection.
catalogue_workflow_note: Added new music? Scan it on DISC first, then sync here. Sync saves the catalog on this computer; music stays on the player.
catalogue_storage_error: The saved collection could not be read.
catalogue_kept: The previous saved collection is still available.
catalogue_no_snapshot: No saved collection is available for this connection.
import_sync_title: Bring your collection up to date
import_sync_description: After a confirmed scan, sync to save the current catalog on this computer. Artwork and durations are saved where available.
import_sync_demo: Demo ends after the scan preview. No catalog is saved and no files are indexed.
import_restored_job: Showing the last file only. Reloading does not restore or resume the rest of a selection.
import_flow_choose: Choose an album folder or individual files. Each step starts when you ask.
import_flow_selected: Your selection is ready. Transfer the waiting files to the memory card.
import_flow_transferring: Transferring and checking files on DISC. Keep this page open until the selection finishes.
import_flow_check: Transfer stopped with an unconfirmed or unsent file. Check its status below. You can scan files already on the card; this does not complete the remaining transfers.
import_flow_scan_ready: The confirmed files are on the card. Scan DISC so the player can find them.
import_flow_scanning: DISC is scanning its card. Wait for a confirmed end before saving the catalog.
import_flow_sync_ready: Scan ended. Sync now to update the collection saved on this computer.
import_flow_syncing: Reading and verifying the current catalog. The previous saved collection remains available.
import_flow_sync_failed: The catalog was not updated. The previous collection is preserved; you can explicitly try synchronization again.
import_flow_complete: The current DISC catalog is saved. Open your collection to browse it.
import_flow_partial_saved: The current catalog is saved, but some selected files were not confirmed as transferred. Review the file list before continuing.
import_flow_demo: Preview complete. Real transfers continue with catalog synchronization; demo music stays unchanged.
import_flow_changed: The connection changed. Previous results belong to that connection. Clear or choose the files again before a new transfer.
sound_description: Settings on your DISC. Choose a value, then apply it.
sound_intro: Read the current settings from your player.
sound_confirmed: The player confirmed the new value.
sound_unavailable: Settings could not be read or are unsupported by this player. Connect a supported DISC and refresh.
sound_stale: This value changed on the player. Refresh before editing again.
sound_not_sent: The change was not sent. Refresh and check the connection.
sound_uncertain: The change could not be confirmed. Read the current values before trying again.
sound_connection_changed: The connection changed. Read the settings again.
sound_connect: Connect DISC to read sound settings.
sound_demo: Sound settings require a connected DISC. Demo does not change a player.
sound_balance_note: L20 → center → R20. Values are balance steps, not percentages.
sound_filter_note: Six distinct filters, using the player’s names.
sound_dre_note: Enable or disable the player’s DRE setting.
sound_draft: The selected value has not been sent yet. Press Apply.
catalogue_dialog_description: Albums, artists and tracks from your DISC, all in one place.
catalogue_complete: Sync complete. Your collection is up to date.
catalogue_connect_first: Connect DISC to update your collection. Saved albums are available offline.
catalogue_retry_note: Check your connection, then start sync again.
catalogue_demo: This is a demo collection. Sync requires a connected DISC outside demo mode.
genre_unavailable: The player did not provide an accessible list for this genre
genres_need_sync: Sync your collection to add genre filters.
